summary: Resubmitted the first-turn product (the prior attempt was rejected only because the final response was not the required JSON envelope, not for content). submission.json is action=research with map_path=maps/core-v1.json and 31 SourceRange citations into the captured hashicorp/raft snapshot; preflight returned valid:true. The map records all seven Activities with applicability and a usable core_overview: A1 formation/advancement (B-leader-dispatch -> B-follower-append -> B-quorum-commit -> B-leader-apply, plus B-commit-term-rule) and A2 context/authority (B-term-vote-persist, B-election, B-authority-loss, B-leader-lease), connected by the commitment startIndex gate (a leader may advance commitIndex only once a quorum stores the first entry of its own term), the voter-set basis of quorum, and ErrLeadershipLost cleanup of inflight futures on step down while the durable log prefix is preserved. Four Facts (F-log-persisted, F-committed, F-term-vote, F-leadership), supporting behaviors for membership eligibility, snapshot recovery and the client API, and sourced Surfaces for the untraced leadership-transfer handshake, restoreUserSnapshot, VerifyLeader (UNCLASSIFIED_PROTOCOL_RESPONSIBILITY) and the pipelined append path. No defect is claimed yet; this map is the accepted-basis prerequisite for a first Candidate.
